## Summary
Viven Gorantla is a second-year B.Tech student (2025–2029) at Geethanjali College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), Hyderabad, India. He builds AI-powered developer tools, agentic workflows, deterministic simulation systems, and cloud-aware backend infrastructure. His engineering ethos centers on: "The AI proposes. Software verifies. A human approves."

## Core Projects

- [PatchLine - AI-Assisted Code Security & Triage](https://github.com/VivenG-2007/patchline.ai): Static analysis findings (Semgrep, Tree-sitter) ground LLM candidate fix generation. Candidates pass an automated verification step before submitting human-reviewed pull requests.
- [Crisis Commander - Advisory Crisis Digital Twin](https://vivengorantla.dev/work/crisis-commander): Deterministic fixed-point simulation cascade engine, risk and blast-radius engines, Zod-validated structured AI proposals, and COMMANDER-level RBAC authorization for critical actions.
- [BLACKBOX AI 1.0 - 1st Place Winner](https://vivengorantla.dev/work/blackbox-ai): 1st Place at GCET IEEE Student Branch / IEEE Computer Society hackathon (6–7 Oct 2026, team localhost:420, per certificate). Empirical black-box probing under a fixed query budget.
- [Reusable Authentication Microservice](https://vivengorantla.dev/work/auth-service): RS256 JWT with refresh-token rotation, HttpOnly cookies, RBAC, Redis-backed rate limiting, multi-device revocation.
- [DBForge AI - Visual Database Schema Generator](https://vivengorantla.dev/work/dbforge-ai): Translates visual ER diagrams and natural language prompts into validated PostgreSQL schemas deployed directly to Supabase.
